question: Window reveals: which reveal faces are finished, to what depth, and in which trade (internal finish vs facade)?
rule_in_this_brief: ordinary openings: left, right and top reveals, 0.25 m depth where applicable
review_finding: every window on the reference plan sits in a 0.20 m wall and its frame is drawn between the faces, often flush with one face: a fixed 0.25 m depth exceeds the drawn wall on every window; the sill (bottom) is not covered by the rule; reveal areas also need the window heights, which no drawing provides
unlocks: 52 reveal records (jamb area = 2 x height x depth; head = width x depth)
depends_on: window heights / sill and head levels (schedule or elevations); SE-10
recommended_answer_or_action: confirm whether 0.25 m includes finishes / cladding not drawn; otherwise depth per side = measured distance from the frame line to the finished face (0 where the frame is flush), with 0.25 m only as an ASSUMED cap; internal and external reveals reported in separate trades; sill handled by SE-10

question: Door reveals: does a PVC internal door frame (jamb lining / architrave) cover the reveal, or is the reveal plastered and painted? Same question for aluminium external doors (inside face)?
rule_in_this_brief: ordinary openings: left, right and top reveals, 0.25 m depth where applicable
review_finding: door walls are 0.15 m (12 doors) and 0.20 m (9): 0.25 m exceeds both; a PVC door set normally includes a jamb lining that covers the reveal, so applying the opening rule to doors may double-measure (reveal finish + door set)
recommended_answer_or_action: state whether 'ordinary openings' includes doors; if the door set includes a lining, door reveals are NOT_APPLICABLE (no duplicate with the door item); if not, measure as SE-01

question: Passages (openings without a door or glazing): which are full height (left and right reveals only) and which have a head (left, right and top)?
ledger_records: OPENING:PASSAGE REVEAL_JAMBS 9 + HEAD_SOFFIT 9, the 3 shaft openings excluded (see SE-04)
rule_in_this_brief: full-height openings: left and right reveals only
review_finding: 2 of the 9 passages have head lines drawn in plan (a head exists: top reveal applies); 7 have no head evidence (needs a section or elevation); one 'passage' is 11.22 m wide along a line of columns in an open plan and is probably not an opening at all
depends_on: sections / elevations; geometry review of the 11.22 m passage
recommended_answer_or_action: decide from drawn head lines where present (4 records now); keep the other 14 UNRESOLVED until a section shows the head; review the 11.22 m passage as geometry before any reveal is measured

question: Is the stacked 1.8 x 1.8 m shaft the lift, and are its three 1.0 m openings the lift landing entrances?
ledger_records: OPENING:PASSAGE REVEAL_JAMBS 3 + HEAD_SOFFIT 3 at the shaft
rule_in_this_brief: lift doors excluded from door quantities and areas; lift shaft excluded from room finishing
review_finding: the shaft is EXCLUDED by inference (stacked footprint); its openings are still ordinary passages with reveal records (F-22)
unlocks: 6 records become EXCLUDED; 3 passage lines leave the ordinary opening BOQ
depends_on: a lift label, a lift schedule or the owner's word
recommended_answer_or_action: if confirmed: LIFT_ENTRANCE, EXCLUDED (owner rule); the landing surround (architrave / cladding) is a lift-package item, not a reveal finish

question: Reveals of door elements that are not yet confirmed openings (6 provisional, 1 unresolved swing)
rule_in_this_brief: do not promote provisional doors on dimension agreement alone
review_finding: not a separate eligibility question: no reveal exists until the opening is confirmed; for the unresolved swing there is no opening at all
recommended_answer_or_action: no RFI of its own: follow SE-02 once the door is confirmed; the unresolved swing's two records should be BLOCKED (no opening), not UNRESOLVED_ELIGIBILITY

question: Thresholds: what finish goes in the floor strip inside the wall thickness at a door or passage (marble threshold piece, the adjoining floor finish carried through, or nothing)?
ledger_records: PASSAGE THRESHOLD 2 (UNRESOLVED_ELIGIBILITY, strips between two non-room faces) + DOOR THRESHOLD 5 (NO_EMITTER: the strip is bounded by more than one opening kind and is not attributed); outside the 140: DOOR THRESHOLD 16 + PASSAGE THRESHOLD 10 (BLOCKED_OWNER_DECISION)
rule_in_this_brief: no duplicate measurement between finish and opening quantities
review_finding: the 5 'NO_EMITTER' records have an emitter that stops on STRIP_NOT_ATTRIBUTED: an engine limit, not a missing emitter (F-21); in wet rooms the doorway strip already carries a measured waterproofing doorway line, so the threshold finish must not repeat the floor finish of either room
depends_on: owner decision Q-S6-1; strip attribution fix
recommended_answer_or_action: owner chooses one threshold rule for doors and one for passages; engineering attributes the 5 strips; the threshold area is then excluded from both adjoining room floors (no duplicate)

question: Is the kitchen (SERVICE) waterproofed like a wet room?
rule_in_this_brief: kitchen waterproofing remains an explicit owner decision
review_finding: kept open: the kitchen stays SERVICE (dry finish rows) and no waterproofing is inferred
unlocks: 1 record (and the kitchen upturn / doorway if approved)
recommended_answer_or_action: owner decides; no engineering change before

question: On what authority does each surface stand? (ceilings, walls, wet areas, thresholds)
ledger_records: ceilings 28 PROVISIONAL on a PROPOSAL row (DRY 11, SERVICE 1, WET 16); walls: plaster / paint / wall tile 56 BLOCKED_MISSING_SOURCE on owner rule UP-CER-009, stair walls 4 BLOCKED_OWNER_DECISION (Q-S6-4); wet floors / waterproofing floor / upturn on owner rules UP-CER-001, UP-WP-001, UP-WP-002 (MEASURED 42, PROVISIONAL 6); thresholds on the open question Q-S6-1
rule_in_this_brief: ceiling, wall, wet-area and threshold eligibility must be independently documented
review_finding: every wall finish is blocked by missing heights (no clear height or tile height source): plaster, paint and wall ceramic have no measured quantity on the reference plan; ceilings rest on a PROPOSAL, not an owner rule
unlocks: the authority of every surface record
depends_on: owner approval of the ELIGIBILITY_V0 ceiling row; heights
recommended_answer_or_action: owner approves or amends the ceiling row; the facts file (heights) is the single largest unlock for walls

question: Ledger completeness: 102 of the 427 V2.1 lines on the reference plan map to no ledger record
review_finding: unmapped: waterproofing doorway strips (13, measured), paint above wall tile (16), stair flights / treads / risers / railings / step lines drawn inside DRY rooms, stair-room flights, ceilings and skirting, closure-strip thresholds, shaft and stair space lines (F-21)
unlocks: an omission count that can be trusted in the blind test
recommended_answer_or_action: add a ledger conservation check (every line in exactly one record, or OUT_OF_LEDGER_SCOPE with a reason) and an ENGINE_LIMIT status, before any omission figure is quoted

question: Window type: sill window or floor-level glazing? (decides the sill strip, the skirting under the window and the bottom reveal)
ledger_records: OPENING:WINDOW SILL_STRIP 26 (BLOCKED_MISSING_SOURCE); every released skirting line with a window
review_finding: the skirting under a window whose frame is drawn on the room face is split 50 / 50 by the engine (F-17): about 8.4 m of the released skirting on the reference plan rests on that split; BA-12 is the visible case
unlocks: 26 sill records and the window part of 12 released skirting lines
recommended_answer_or_action: per window: sill height (or floor level) from the schedule; until then the window share of skirting is a REVIEW range [floor-level, sill], not a released figure
